title: Long-code value identity
statement: Let $G$ be a regular unique game, let $T$ be a finite randomised tester over its alphabet, and let $F$ assign a sign-valued Boolean function to each vertex of $G$. The experiment value of $F$ equals the uniform average over vertices of the tester's acceptance probability on the function obtained by averaging the permuted responses from neighbouring vertices.
hypotheses_covered: A finite randomised tester T over the game's alphabet
